meta.prompt_suffix: Style: candid documentary photograph of a real place, not an advertisement, not CGI, not a composite. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at about f/2.8, standing eye level, available light only, true-to-life restrained color, mild sensor noise, a slight handheld tilt, honest texture on skin, wood, glass and metal. Signs may clip a little but the overall image stays natural — never glowing, never hyper-saturated, no HDR look, no rim-light effects, no lens flare. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short numerals explicitly named in the scene description above; every other surface that would carry writing — wall notices, forms, receipts, statements, ledgers, price cards, signs and labels — shows wavy ink strokes and ruled rows that form no readable letters. No english text, no latin letters, no fake chinese characters, no gibberish lettering, no invented words. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '이 침대 한 자리에 한 달치 청구서가 이만큼 쌓인다' — 요양병원 6인실 한 달 최소 140만원(병원비 70+간병비 60+기저귓값 10)과 '간병인의 79.5%가 60대 이상'이라는 돌봄 역전 장면을 한 프레임에 넣었다. 구멍 ③ 지출 파트의 근거 장면이라 현장 구도를 골랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the photograph fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge with a real scene — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block, and never a large expanse of bare empty floor. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the dark shadowed shoulders and back of the woman nearest the camera, so far out of focus and so deeply in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no hand, no screen and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, hand, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths. Counters and bed rails run across the MIDDLE of the frame, never near the bottom edge, and anything resting on them sits at mid height. SCALE, EQUALLY IMPORTANT: the Korean woman in her early sixties is the largest thing in the picture — her head and shoulders occupy the entire right third of the frame, her face alone spans roughly the top 55 to 60 percent of the frame height, the top of her permed grey hair touches the upper edge and is very slightly cropped by it, and her shoulder leaves the frame on the right. The other people in the ward are far smaller, roughly one third of her head height. Scene: photographed from just inside a six-bed Korean long-term care hospital room, camera at standing eye level. Cold white fluorescent tubes in the ceiling are the only light; the left two thirds of the frame show the repeating row of six iron bed frames with worn vinyl mattresses, an IV stand, a folded wheelchair, plastic urinal bottles and a taped-up curtain rail, all at mid frame height and slightly out of focus. In her raised left hand, held at chest-to-shoulder height, is a thick fan of thin hospital billing slips, each ruled into rows of wavy ink strokes that form no readable letters, the top slip curling from being gripped. Behind her, an equally grey-haired caregiver in her seventies is bent over a bed rail trying to lift a patient, her back rounded with effort. The woman in the foreground wears a nylon jacket over a floral blouse and a hospital visitor tag clipped to her collar. Her expression: eyelids lowered as she stares down at the slips, lower lip pulled in and bitten, deep vertical line between the brows, her free hand pressed flat against her forehead, jaw set.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '좌판은 물건으로 꽉 찼는데 내 장바구니는 대파 한 단이다' — 세후 예금이자 연 2.6% 대 물가 2.8~3.2%, 1억 넣어 한 달 21만 7,000원이라는 구멍 ② 수치를 시장 물가(김밥 3,300원·삼계탕 16,600원)로 착지시킨 장면.

The other shoppers are far smaller, roughly one third of his head height. Scene: photographed inside a covered Korean traditional market alley on an overcast afternoon, camera at standing eye level, soft grey daylight leaking in from the roof vents mixed with a few warm bulbs over the stalls. He stands at the left, a thin nylon market basket hanging from his forearm at chest height with a single bundle of scallions in it and nothing else. Both hands hold his worn brown leather wallet open in front of his chest, one crumpled banknote and a transit card visible inside. He wears a faded windbreaker over a checked shirt. His expression: eyebrows lifted high in the middle, eyes fixed blankly down into the open wallet, mouth slightly parted, shoulders dropped, thumb frozen mid-motion against the empty note slot.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 한 줄 = '평생 부었는데 종이에 적힌 숫자가 700,427이다' — 확정 제목의 인용문 "월 70만원입니다"를 그대로 이행하는 컷. 노령연금 전체 평균 월 70만 427원(2026.1)이 근거이며 숫자만 인쇄로 남기고 나머지 활자는 전부 읽을 수 없는 획으로 처리했다.

His expression: eyes narrowed to slits as he reads the figure a second time, head tilted toward the sheet, the middle finger of his free hand pushing his glasses up the bridge of his nose, mouth closed with the corners pulled slightly down, forehead creased in three lines.

Her expression: looking straight into the lens without blinking, chin very slightly lowered, one corner of the mouth pressed flat and inward while the other stays level, lower eyelids tightened, brows almost still — not anger, the quiet look of someone who has already done the arithmetic.

Behind him the branch fills the background in soft focus under neutral grey-white fluorescent light: a glass partition, a long teller counter at mid frame height, a wall board and pinned notices printed only in wavy ink strokes that form no readable letters, a row of steel waiting chairs and a water cooler. At the right edge of the frame, raised to just above shoulder height beside his face so it never covers it, he holds one official statement sheet turned toward the camera: the sheet is ruled into rows of wavy ink strokes with no readable letters except one large clean printed figure reading "700,427" alone in the middle, and the paper is the only bright mass in the picture. His other hand grips a crumpled hiking cap he has just taken off, held at chest height. He wears a windbreaker with a faded club emblem and a knitted vest. His expression: eyes squinted almost shut behind deep crow's feet as he re-reads the figure, brows drawn hard together, head pushed slightly forward on the neck, lips parted just enough to show he was about to say something and stopped, the hand holding the sheet visibly tightened so the paper buckles.
